name: gnome-same-session-computer-use
description: Operate existing GNOME/Mutter windows through a recoverable focus lease.

interface.shortDescription: Recoverable control of existing GNOME apps.
interface.longDescription: Adds stable GNOME window discovery, focused-window capture, and explicitly acknowledged global-seat input transactions which restore focus, workspace, and pointer state.
defaultPrompt: Use my existing logged-in GNOME app to complete this task.
Operate this GNOME window with a recoverable focus lease.
